name: LPG and ammonia carriers
principle: Gas carriers move LPG and ammonia as pressurised, semi-refrigerated or fully refrigerated cargo. Fully refrigerated ships of 50,000 to 80,000 m³ are VLGCs and carry ammonia alongside LPG in Type A tanks; IGC Code Chapter 16 (adopted for 1 July 2026) allows liquefied ammonia as fuel on gas carriers.

process_steps.name: Voyage with cargo refrigeration or pressure

source.note: Wikipedia, Gas carrier, read 25 October 2026 (secondary source)
